rule: a proof record states its set, target, profile and toolchain; a bare cargo command selects HOST_NATIVE_SET (default-members) and never the whole project; CROSS_SET and HEURISTIC records carry proof weight NONE

WASM64_KERNEL_SET.evidence_basis: D9 T9-P3-04, T9-P5-02/03, T9-P8-* ran on rustc 1.100.0-nightly (6eeff9a52 2026-09-23); KRN-D13-B reproduced D9's kernel byte-for-byte

kernel_identity.note: D18: the kernel identity is exec_identity - install-name independent (D17 FACT-KERNEL-EXEC-SECTIONS-INSTALL-INDEPENDENT: under two rustup install names only the custom "name" section differs, LLVM promoted-symbol hashes).  The whole-file sha256 differs per install name and stays recorded in by_install_name (informational, never the verdict).  Historical: D13 declared identity per install name only (H-12 [GAP]).

exec_identity.algorithm: sha256 over (section id byte ++ section body) of every section except the excluded custom sections, in module order (tests/implementation/wasm-sections.mjs identity_excluding_custom)

ALL_SOURCES.target: none (rustfmt reads files; nothing is compiled)

ALL_MEMBERS_GRAPH.selection: every workspace member + every physical Cargo.toml under the root

CROSS_SET.meaning: diagnostic only: records that a host --workspace build/clippy cannot succeed (factc-wasm-abi has no host panic_handler by design) and that --workspace tests compile it only in the test harness; never a proof of either set
